# Pharos

> Pharos tracks 353 active stablecoins across major chains with depeg alerts, liquidity scores, on-chain safety signals, dependency-risk scoring, and report-card-style risk summaries. Data refreshes multiple times per day from the Pharos Cloudflare Worker API.

## Core Data

- [Dashboard homepage](https://pharos.watch/): Market overview with KPI bar, peg-score heatmap, and stablecoin list.
- [Safety Scores](https://pharos.watch/safety-scores/): Weighted Liquidity / Resilience / Decentralization / Dependency + peg-stability multiplier, A+ to F.
- [Pharos Stability Index](https://pharos.watch/stability-index/): Aggregate market-stability gauge with history chart.
- [DEWS (Depeg Early Warning System)](https://pharos.watch/depeg/): Active depegs, watch-list, and historical DEWS bands.
- [Liquidity](https://pharos.watch/liquidity/): DEX liquidity scores, pool counts, TVL depth.
- [Yield](https://pharos.watch/yield/): Yield-bearing stablecoin intelligence.
- [Non-USD Market Structure](https://pharos.watch/alt-pegs/): Historical and current market structure for non-USD stablecoin cohorts.
- [Chains](https://pharos.watch/chains/): Per-chain stablecoin distribution and health.
- [Flows](https://pharos.watch/flows/): Mint/burn flow dashboards.
- [FreezeWatch](https://pharos.watch/freezewatch/): Issuer freeze events and exposure.
- [Dependency Map](https://pharos.watch/dependency-map/): Inter-stablecoin dependency graph.
- [Coverage](https://pharos.watch/coverage/): What Pharos tracks and what it does not.
- [Cemetery](https://pharos.watch/cemetery/): 91 defunct stablecoins and their causes of death.
- [Stablecoin Cemetery dataset (JSON)](https://pharos.watch/datasets/stablecoin-cemetery.json): Citation-ready dataset of failed, discontinued, and abandoned stablecoins.
- [Stablecoin Cemetery dataset (CSV)](https://pharos.watch/datasets/stablecoin-cemetery.csv): Tabular export of the Stablecoin Cemetery dataset.
- [Upcoming](https://pharos.watch/upcoming/): Pre-launch stablecoins Pharos is tracking.

- [Methodology Hub](https://pharos.watch/methodology/): Full scoring model for safety, peg, liquidity, yield, contagion.
- [Safety Scores Changelog](https://pharos.watch/methodology/scoring-changelog/): Every weight change since v1.0.

## API

- [API Access](https://pharos.watch/api/): Email-verified self-serve API key request flow.
- [API Reference](https://pharos.watch/about/api/): Public and ops lanes, auth model, endpoint catalogue.
- [OpenAPI spec](https://pharos.watch/openapi.json): Machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 endpoint catalogue for the Pharos API.
- [Postman collection](https://pharos.watch/postman/pharos-api.postman_collection.json): Importable Pharos API collection for external integrations.
- [Postman environment](https://pharos.watch/postman/pharos-api.postman_environment.json): Production environment template with API key placeholder.
- [Funding](https://pharos.watch/funding/): Public ledger of Pharos running costs, donations, and sustainability path.
- [About](https://pharos.watch/about/): Project context and data sources.

## Changelog

- [Weekly Changelog](https://pharos.watch/changelog/): Release notes.
- [Daily Digest Archive](https://pharos.watch/digest/): Daily market recaps.

## Docs

- [Documentation Archive](https://pharos.watch/docs/): Architecture, methodology, and design documentation.
- [API Reference](https://pharos.watch/docs/api-reference/): HTTP contracts, authentication notes, and response conventions.
- [Architecture](https://pharos.watch/docs/architecture/): Route map, API surfaces, runtime rules, and SEO ownership.
- [Data Flow Map](https://pharos.watch/docs/data-flow-map/): End-to-end source-to-UI flows for each major data domain.
- [Data Pipeline](https://pharos.watch/docs/data-pipeline/): Price enrichment, integrity guardrails, and sync behavior.
- [Worker and API Limits](https://pharos.watch/docs/worker-and-api-limits/): Repo-enforced runtime limits, cron budgets, and polling guidance.
- [Classification](https://pharos.watch/docs/classification/): Classification system, peg handling, and commodity treatment.
- [Pricing Pipeline](https://pharos.watch/docs/pricing-pipeline/): Live-price consensus, overrides, and fallback enrichment.
- [Depeg Detection](https://pharos.watch/docs/depeg-detection/): Two-stage detection, confirmation, and peg score inputs.
- [DEWS](https://pharos.watch/docs/dews/): DEWS formula, sub-signals, bands, and API contract.
- [DEX Liquidity](https://pharos.watch/docs/dex-liquidity/): Liquidity score, discovery pipeline, and cross-validation.
- [Pharos Stability Index](https://pharos.watch/docs/stability-index/): PSI formula, bands, storage, and API surface.
- [Report Cards](https://pharos.watch/docs/report-cards/): Report-card scoring, portfolio analyzer, and stress test.
- [Redemption Backstops](https://pharos.watch/docs/redemption-backstops/): Redemption routes, effective-exit scoring, and storage.
- [Chain Health](https://pharos.watch/docs/chain-health/): Chain Health Score inputs, formula, factors, and bands.
- [Mint Burn Flows](https://pharos.watch/docs/mint-burn-flows/): Mint/burn ingestion, scoring, and admin backfills.
- [Yield Intelligence](https://pharos.watch/docs/yield-intelligence/): APY resolution, PYS scoring, and warning signals.
- [Shadow Stablecoins](https://pharos.watch/docs/shadow-stablecoins/): PSI-only shadow asset boundary and UI exclusion rules.
- [Design Context](https://pharos.watch/docs/design-context/): User, brand, and product-direction baseline.
- [Design Language](https://pharos.watch/docs/design-language/): Live UI patterns, typography, spacing, and responsive rules.
- [Design Tokens](https://pharos.watch/docs/design-tokens/): Token layers and CSS variable architecture.

Docs support `Accept: text/markdown` content negotiation for agent consumption.

## Digest

- [USDC's Record Hid the Rot](https://pharos.watch/digest/2026-03-16-weekly/): USDC hit a $79.22B ATH while 84 depeg events and 222 blacklists piled up beneath a BEDROCK PSI that never flinched.
- [The Quiet Escalation](https://pharos.watch/digest/2026-03-16/): MUSD enters DEWS ALERT on liquidity erosion while its TVL quintupled overnight to $56.18M. Contradictions like that are how $18.65M coins become case studies.
- [Triple Reversal Day](https://pharos.watch/digest/2026-03-15/): USDC, USDT, and USDe all reversed their weekly flow direction in a single day. The Bank Run Gauge reads CAUTIOUS. Six days of BEDROCK, and the plumbing just flinched.
- [The Cracks Beneath Bedrock](https://pharos.watch/digest/2026-03-14/): PSI at 90.8, its lowest in 6 days, as KAG sits 488 bps off-peg on $314M and USDC's $79.22B ATH meets a quiet outflow.
- [USDC Touches Its Ceiling](https://pharos.watch/digest/2026-03-13/): USDC hit its all-time high at $78.88B while LUSD and USDA both escalated to ALERT. PSI reads 92.8, BEDROCK, but record supply and rising stress signals make for an uneasy calm.
- [Two New Alerts, Zero Panic](https://pharos.watch/digest/2026-03-12/): SUSD and USDA both jumped to ALERT on cross-source divergence while PSI holds 91.9 BEDROCK. Four ALERT signals under a calm index is a contradiction with an expiration date.
- [USDC Touches Its Ceiling](https://pharos.watch/digest/2026-03-11/): USDC stalled $10M short of its $78.71B ATH while PSI dipped to 93.2, its lowest since March 9. Two growth stories hit the brakes on the same day.
- [USDC Flirts With Its Ceiling](https://pharos.watch/digest/2026-03-10/): USDC at $78.25B is 0.4% from its all-time high. DEWS ALERT count jumped from 1 to 5 in 24 hours. PSI reads 93.9 BEDROCK, serene as a lake with something moving underneath.
- [Sixty Coins Blink Yellow](https://pharos.watch/digest/2026-03-09/): 60 DEWS coins shifted to WATCH in 24h, up from 36, while PSI sits at 91.2 BEDROCK. The stress the index won't show is spreading across the middle shelf.
- [KAU Returns, Briefly](https://pharos.watch/digest/2026-03-08/): PSI 89.7, STEADY. KAU recovered from 606 bps in 15h on $420M, then re-depegged to 913 bps. USDC and USDT both reversed to net negative yesterday after a combined $2.44B weekly gain. PYUSD moved the other direction.
- [Three Reversals, One Footnote](https://pharos.watch/digest/2026-03-07/): PSI 93.4, BEDROCK. USDT, USDC, and DAI all reversed supply in one day, draining a combined $72M while PYUSD accelerated 5x its weekly pace. KAU holds 452 bps off-peg on $413.57M and is the only active depeg worth your attention.
- [DAI Wakes Up, GYEN Stays Down](https://pharos.watch/digest/2026-03-06/): PSI 94, BEDROCK. DAI added $172M in one day against a $75M weekly average. 49 blacklist events, $1.47M in USDT destroys. GYEN at -2957 bps is a condition, not an event. USDC grew $1.91B to $77.24B without comment.
- [USDS Accelerates, BEDROCK Nods](https://pharos.watch/digest/2026-03-05/): PSI 92.8, BEDROCK. USD1 reversed from -$87M weekly to fresh minting in 24h. USDS at $273M daily is accelerating. USDC added $1.66B to $77.08B without incident. KAG resolved 337 bps on $303M again.
- [BEDROCK Holds, KAG Sprints](https://pharos.watch/digest/2026-03-04/): PSI 94.3, BEDROCK. KAG depegged 3 times on $314.86M and recovered each time inside an hour. USDC added $1.42B to $76.40B. USDT ran 4 blacklist freezes on Ethereum totaling $282.34K across 32 events in 24 hours.
- [BEDROCK Slips, Quietly](https://pharos.watch/digest/2026-03-03/): PSI down 3.1 points to 91.9 in BEDROCK. USDC added $1.25B to $76.02B. KAU resolved 2036 bps on $408M in 8h. USDT ran 3 destroy events totaling $2.83M on Ethereum. NECT: F-rated, liquidity 16, still 146 bps off-peg.
- [KAU's Busy Week, USDT's Busy Morning](https://pharos.watch/digest/2026-03-02/): PSI 92.5, BEDROCK. USDT, USDC, and PYUSD all reversed supply direction in 24 hours. KAU resolved a 2036 bps depeg on $411.52M. LUSD sits 138 bps off-peg with a liquidity score of 38.
- [Gold Spikes, USDS Surges](https://pharos.watch/digest/2026-03-01/): KAU depegged twice in one day on $399.63M. USDT reversed $85M after a $861M week. USDS accelerated to +$406M. PSI 94.3, BEDROCK, median safety C.
- [Gold Moves, Cops Busy](https://pharos.watch/digest/2026-02-28/): Gold Moves, Cops Busy XAUT +$222M and PAXG +$73M yesterday, both accelerating. USDT hit $183.56B while running 7 blacklist actions on $2.07M. PSI 95, BEDROCK. The stablecoin market is calm. Its largest issuer is not resting.
- [BEDROCK, Untroubled](https://pharos.watch/digest/2026-02-27/): PSI ticks to 96.1 in BEDROCK, where severity sits at 0.03 and the loudest depeg is EURS at 919 bps on $8.59M — numbers that imply crisis and deliver almost none.
- [USDC Grows Up Fast](https://pharos.watch/digest/2026-02-26/): PSI climbed to 95.9 in BEDROCK as USDC quietly added $1.82B in seven days to reach $75.45B, making it the only stablecoin doing real work this week.
